title: Cannot access part of window nor move window behind to allow access

status.label: Retest remap dialog positioning
status.detail: On v0.98, remap dialog controls can be off-screen and neither the dialog nor its editor owner can be moved; closing the dialog restores editor movement.

judgment.rationale: The report gives a specific new-editor scenario: save/cancel controls can be off-screen, and while the remap dialog is open neither it nor its owner can be repositioned; closing the dialog restores movement. The report is from v0.98 and one maintainer comment asks whether a screenshot depicts the issue, but there is no current-build confirmation or display resolution/scaling. These details determine whether this is still a layout defect and what display geometry triggers it.
evidence: The reporter lists PowerToys 0.98.0 and Keyboard Manager.
The remap dialog can place Save/Cancel outside the visible area and the owner/editor cannot be moved while the dialog is open.
The reporter says closing the dialog allows the editor to be repositioned; resizing and maximizing are possible.
One maintainer comment asks if the reporter-provided screenshot represents the issue; there is no reporter reply confirming it.
judgment.recommended_action: Retest on v0.102.3001 and report display resolution/scaling plus whether dragging either title bar works while the remap dialog is open.

fix_assessment.rationale: The modal dialog and owner may be constrained to an off-screen or non-movable layout, but the current build and display geometry are unconfirmed.

proposed_fixes.title: Keep remap dialog controls accessible and windows movable
proposed_fixes.root_cause: The new editor may position the remap dialog or owner outside the usable work area and fail to provide a movable title bar when the dialog is open.
plan: Reproduce on v0.102.3001 and record screen resolution, scaling, and the remap dialog state.
Determine whether the dialog or owner is outside the work area or its drag handling is disabled while modal.
Keep required controls visible and allow recovery by moving/resizing the dialog or owner; add UI coverage for scaled and constrained window sizes.
verification: Verify Save/Cancel remain visible or the dialog can be repositioned at the reported display configuration.
Verify the owner editor can be recovered without closing the dialog.

confidence.rationale: The window interaction is described clearly, but only v0.98 is reported and the display geometry and current behavior are unknown.

issue_context.summary: Keyboard Manager remap dialog controls may be off-screen while the dialog and its editor owner cannot be moved.
known_information: The report lists v0.98.0 and the new Keyboard Manager editor.
Save/Cancel can be outside the visible area; neither dialog nor editor can be repositioned until the dialog is closed.
The editor can be resized or maximized, but title-bar drag does not respond.
A maintainer posted a screenshot question; no reporter confirmation appears in the thread.
inferences: Display scaling or available work area may contribute, but the issue gives no resolution or scaling information.
issue_context.analysis: The report has enough detail to identify the blocked interaction, so do not ask for a generic repro. A current-build test with display geometry will show whether the layout/drag issue remains and which window cannot be recovered.
initial_investigation: Read the full issue and the single maintainer comment.
Recorded the existing description that closing the modal dialog restores editor movement.
Confirmed the reported build is v0.98.0 and no display resolution/scaling or current-build test is provided.

information_gaps.how_to_collect: Repeat the same remap-dialog workflow on v0.102.3001.
information_gaps.information: Whether the off-screen controls and non-movable windows reproduce on v0.102.3001.

information_gaps.why_needed: Window work-area and scaling determine whether the controls become inaccessible and whether the issue is layout-specific.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Report the affected display resolution and Windows scaling percentage, then test dragging the dialog and editor title bars while the dialog remains open.
information_gaps.information: The affected display resolution and scaling, and which of the dialog/editor title bars can be moved while the dialog is open.

comment.body:
Thanks for describing that Save/Cancel can be off-screen and closing the remap dialog restores editor movement. A maintainer also asked whether the screenshot in the thread shows the same state, but there is no confirmation yet.

Could you please:
1. Retest the same workflow on v0.102.3001 and report whether Save/Cancel are still inaccessible and whether dragging the dialog or editor title bar works while the dialog is open.
2. Include the affected display resolution and Windows scaling percentage.
This will distinguish a current dialog layout/drag defect from a display-specific off-screen state.
